items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: Well, Jacobson told me once that he felt a little resentment of Teschmacher... But for my part, that's what I love. I, I only know the records, naturally.

ctx.x: And yet he, I think, would be one of the first to say that, well, he was trying to play the rules that Teschmacher laid down. He'd constantly refer to Teschmacher's solo as the right way to play it.
This is Klass or... Or Jacobson. Jacobson, really?
